MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper felt useful because it could help me check screw diameters and hardware dimensions when matching fasteners to a job.",
    "That measuring tool connected to the practical fastening work suggested by my nails, screws, and wall anchors. It was the only recommendation I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Relay harnesses, heat shrink tubing, spade connectors, and test leads require electrical projects that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "The pipe coupling and cutting wheels assume a particular repair or compatible equipment, while the thermometer serves a measurement need I have not shown.",
    "The glue packs felt unnecessary because I have been choosing mechanical fasteners, and neither twelve tubes nor twenty-four bottles fits an adhesive need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "Items used somewhere around household maintenance seemed to count as related even when they serve very different tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors point most clearly toward fastening and mounting work.",
    "Specific dimensions and compatibility matter: a tool that helps check hardware sizes is useful, while a particular pipe fitting or grinder accessory needs a confirmed use.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags suggest separate practical needs; they do not establish an ongoing interest in unrelated repair supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a practical maintenance interest but mostly missed my more specific need for fastening supplies and tools that support that work."
}
